activity.notes: The Hungarian National Assembly elected Miklós Horthy Regent on 1 March 1920 in the restored Kingdom of Hungary. His de facto regency ended on 16 October 1944, when German pressure and the Arrow Cross takeover forced the transfer of power. ATLAS uses Kingdom of Hungary rather than a generic Hungary label because the legal state form in the Horthy era was a monarchy without a reigning king.
